source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-length color-2 line is the boundary; the other non-background
    # color marks the shape to move against it.
    line_color = 2
    row_line = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == line_color for v in grid[r])), None)
    col_line = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h))), None)
    if row_line is not None:
        bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, line_color)]
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in obj), max(r for r,c in obj)
        shift = (row_line + 1 - lo) if hi < row_line else (row_line - 1 - hi)
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r+shift][c] = grid[r][c]
        edge = lo+shift if hi < row_line else hi+shift
        stripe = edge-1 if hi < row_line else edge+1
        if 0 <= stripe < h:
            out[stripe] = [8]*w
        return out
    if col_line is not None:
        bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, line_color)]
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in obj), max(c for r,c in obj)
        shift = (col_line + 1 - lo) if hi < col_line else (col_line - 1 - hi)
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c+shift] = grid[r][c]
        edge = lo+shift if hi < col_line else hi+shift
        stripe = edge-1 if hi < col_line else edge+1
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][stripe] = 8
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
